m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Ah, salutations, Wizard. Or is it, Scion of Bartleby, now? Irregardless, I am most grateful that you have come in this our hour of need.
As you may know, we Insects of the Subterranean Sanitation Operations have used the Drains to process Topsider garbage for generations.
Normally, we have no problem dealing with all manner of foul refuse. However, these are not normal times. At present, the trash is revolting.
And I do not mean that the trash is malodorous. I mean the trash has developed sentience, organized, and taken over the Dump in a violent coup.
Please, Scion, go conversate with the Dump Foreman and devise a plan to quash this Trash Monster rebellion before it spills over to Wizard City!
Gah! Oo, sorry. No offense, but yous Topsiders are terrifying to look at. You must be the infamous Scion of Bartleby. Glad you're here.
The Boss says your Scionical razzmatazz is our best hope. First things first, we gotta figure out what's bringing the Trash to life.
If you preoccupy the Trash Monsters wit' some of that fancy spell-slinging you do, I'll sneak around and sees if I can find the root cause.
While you had them distracted, I was able to identify the cause of this refuse rebellion: Goo. Or should I say, <ITALICS>Magical</ITALICS> Goo!
Thanks for coming, Wizard. Subterranean Sanitation Operations reports there's some kind of problem in the Drains.
I offered to check it out myself, but the Sanitation Boss claims that you are the only 'Topsider' he trusts to handle the matter. Will you help?
Great! The Boss is right below us waiting for you. You can use that Manhole right there. Good luck!
The Sanitation Operations Boss sounded pretty upset. You might want to hurry down that Manhole to the Drains to see what's going on!
